execution.order: serial in listed case order; one external RTTOV runK per case

geometry_policy.angle_method: archived ami_geometry ECEF satellite-minus-ellipsoid-point line of sight using the same GEOS metadata and unchanged native surface HGT in both cases
geometry_policy.centroid_sensitivity_only: same native j86/i48 State, Forcing, column, surface, and pressure are used; only the location passed to ami_geometry for RTTOV viewing angles changes from fixed AMI candidate center to saved native cell center
geometry_policy.not_parallax: no CTH/height adjustment, no footprint overlap claim, no product-corrected VIIRS coordinate, no pixel-time inference, and no native cell/state reassignment
geometry_policy.sun_angles: explicit zero angles; thermal-only RTTOV namelist requires solar=false
geometry_policy.surface_elevation: actual selected WRF HGT for each saved frame in both geometries; no height perturbation

limits: H(host(t)) is not H(M(xb)); none of these direct snapshots advances KDM6.
The 05:57:00 and 05:57:40 labels fall inside the conditional file-level AMI scene interval only under its recorded synchronization assumption; per-pixel UTC remains unverified.
The geometry comparison changes the point used for RTTOV viewing angles while holding the selected native column fixed; it is not true parallax, footprint validation, or a geolocation correction.
No time, geometry, surface, or model-column scenario will be selected after seeing BT results; the full 3x2 matrix and support gate are fixed here.

observations_and_support.quality_policy: use exactly the baseline initial-closure frozen all-seven mask; each direct H must retain rad_quality=0 on all seven to receive a cost; never shrink or recompute a favorable subset
